## History

Carson is mentioned in local gossip during a June evening conversation among [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). His name arises alongside news of Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and community reactions to Anne's rejection of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Beyond his inclusion in these local discussions, no direct actions or personal experiences involving Carson are observed.
